hook.line: Claude is a hundred percent better than ChatGPT.
hook.visual: Guest in a leather jacket at a podcast mic, white 'Claude vs. ChatGPT: Who is better?' title box, green-and-white bold word-by-word captions mid-frame.

beats.what: Guest makes the bold claim under the 'Who is better?' question title.
Two-up stack: host on top pushes back that ChatGPT is better.
Guest repeats 'no, no, no' and urges trying Claude.
Stacked layout: host on top, guest below; guest says he pays for both.
Claim: Claude is good at thinking depth, ChatGPT at fast response.
Explains the top model takes time to think.
Wide shot of the guest in an armchair to close.

why_it_works: Versus question in the title, answered with a 100% claim within 3 s, picks a side people want to argue with (517 comments).
Live disagreement from the host gives friction in the first 6 s instead of a monologue.
Keyword-coloured word-by-word captions carry the line even through accent and code-switching.
weaknesses: The argument is vague and the speech hard to follow; the post caption has to restate the case.
Weak ending: it cuts off mid-word on a wide shot with no payoff or CTA.
Long stretches (up to 19.5 s) of the same stacked framing.
for_robert: Stage a disagreement: Fred can play the sceptic who says the opposite in the first 5 s, so your reel opens on friction instead of a monologue.
